# Maria Madeira

> Maria Madeira is a growth strategist for brands that sell online, covering website strategy, AI search (Answer Engine Optimisation), email marketing and Klaviyo, paid acquisition, and creative direction. Based in Lisbon, working globally.

Verified results from recent engagements include £134K in email-attributed revenue over 12 months (up 88.9% year on year, over a third of total store revenue), a 50.4% average campaign open rate, and Google Ads at a 532% ROAS against a 400% break-even over 11 months.

## Partnerships
- Official Klaviyo Partner (K:Partners programme).
- Influee partner for UGC and creator campaigns: https://influee.co/partnership/maria-madeira

## Services
- [Website Strategy & Build](https://mariamadeira.com/services/websites): strategy, rebuilds and targeted improvements with SEO and AEO built in from the start.
- [Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO)](https://mariamadeira.com/services/aeo): getting cited and recommended by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews.
- [Email Marketing & Klaviyo Consulting](https://mariamadeira.com/services/email-marketing): lifecycle flows, segmentation and campaigns that turn email into a compounding, attributed-revenue channel.
- [Paid advertising](https://mariamadeira.com/services/paid-ads): Google, Meta and Microsoft Ads for e-commerce brands, managed against the client's break-even ROAS. Example: 532% ROAS against a 400% break-even over 11 months.
- [All services](https://mariamadeira.com/services): the full list, including growth strategy, paid advertising, creative direction and e-commerce platform migration.

## Pricing (UK, GBP, starting prices)
- AEO audit from £750; ongoing AEO from £800 a month
- Klaviyo setup with core flows from £1,200; monthly email marketing from £750 a month
- Google Ads or Meta Ads management from £500 a month per platform, ad spend not included
- Ways to work: Growth Audit £750 one-off; projects from £1,200; monthly work from £500 a month (minimum three months). Full details at [/pricing](https://mariamadeira.com/pricing).

## Case studies
- [Email lifecycle revenue growth](https://mariamadeira.com/case-study-email): a Klaviyo lifecycle system that grew email-attributed revenue to £134K over 12 months.
- [Google Ads revenue growth](https://mariamadeira.com/case-study-google-ads): structured campaigns delivering a 532% ROAS against a 400% break-even over 11 months.
- [SEO & platform migration](https://mariamadeira.com/case-study-seo): recovering organic and answer-engine visibility after a WordPress to Shopify migration.
- [The Bodysurf School](https://mariamadeira.com/case-study-bodysurf-school): a brochure site rebuilt into a bilingual booking engine with SEO and AEO foundations.
- [Click & Collect](https://mariamadeira.com/case-study-click-collect): a mobile pre-order experience for a high-traffic retail store.

## Writing
- [What is AEO? Answer Engine Optimisation explained](https://mariamadeira.com/blog/what-is-aeo): how brands get cited by AI answer engines, how AEO differs from SEO and GEO, and where to start.
- [Why your automated emails earn more than your campaigns](https://mariamadeira.com/blog/klaviyo-flows-vs-campaigns): automated flows are a small share of sends and a large share of email revenue. What the research says, four years of data from a real UK brand, and the flows to build first.
- [Inside ChatGPT Ads in Europe](https://mariamadeira.com/blog/chatgpt-ads-europe): a walkthrough of opening a European ChatGPT advertiser account, the real minimums and limits, and why AEO comes first.
